ReviewI.LocalArithmetic.both_tests_finiteLocalTerm_piecewise.{u_1} (K : Type u_1) [Field K] [NumberField K]
  (phi : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K → ℂ)
  (hphi : ∀ (x : MasulloGRH.HeckeIdeleClasses K), Masullo.IdeleClassGeometry.classLog K x = 0 → phi x = 0) (q : Fin 2)
  (v : NumberField.FinitePlace K)
  [MeasurableSpace (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v.maximalIdeal)ˣ]
  (nu : MeasureTheory.Measure (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v.maximalIdeal)ˣ) :
  NLocalArithmetic.finiteLocalTerm K v nu (LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q) =
    ↑(NLocalArithmetic.finiteLocalCoefficient K v nu) *
      ∫ (u : (IsDedekindDomain.HeightOneSpectrum.adicCompletion K v.maximalIdeal)ˣ),
        if ‖↑u‖ < 1 then LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q ((NLocalArithmetic.finiteClass K v) u) * ↑√‖↑u‖
        else
          if ‖↑u‖ = 1 then 0 else LIntegrated.requiredTest K phi q ((NLocalArithmetic.finiteClass K v) u) / ↑√‖↑u‖ ∂nu
